title: Deposits of impact structures (design values: no USGS model exists)
percentile_convention: USGS: p90 is the value that 90% of deposits equal or exceed (the small end); p10 the large end

sources.citation: Grieve, R.A.F., and Masaitis, V.L., 1994, The economic potential of terrestrial impact craters: International Geology Review, v. 36, no. 2, p. 105-151 (not a USGS source; descriptive, no grade-tonnage model)

Deep Time design values (P2-08, 2026-10-01): no USGS grade-tonnage or deposit-density model covers deposits of impact structures; each impact deposit type states its own tonnage, grades and density as placeholders in its notes

tonnage_mt.note: Not used: every impact type carries its own tonnage percentiles.

deposits_per_1e5_km2.note: Per 100,000 km² of crater floor, not of a geologic province: the permissive tract of an impact type is the inside of a crater.
